newsitem.title: USA: NY Gov gets $113 mln of aid, half earmarked to NYC.
newsitem.headline: NY Gov gets $113 mln of aid, half earmarked to NYC.

text.p: New York State Gov. George Pataki Monday said he got over $113 million in federal aid for local governments -- some of which had been held up since 1989 -- with over half the sum earmarked for New York City.

It took the state Department of Social Services more than a year of discussions with federal Department of Health and Human Services to get Washington to approve New York State's local close allocation plan for children's welfare services.

Washington had declined to repay local governments for child protective services, including child abuse probes, foster care casework and preventive services, like counseling and homemaker assistance, according to Pataki.
"This aid will help local governments in their efforts to balance their budgets and provide tax relief for local taxpayers," said Pataki, in prepared remarks.
New York City was more than $57 million of the total.
